{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders only
total_revenue = real_orders[real_orders['status'] == 'completed']['revenue'].sum()

# Print the number of real orders and completed orders
print("Number of real orders (excluding test orders):", len(real_orders))
print("Number of completed orders (among real orders):", len(real_orders[real_orders['status'] == 'completed']))

# Print the total revenue
print("Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders):", total_revenue)"}
